title: Run the desktop yourself
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

Everything here comes from Unit 1: the dock, window buttons, and the menu bar along the top.

playgroundTask.goal: You ran the desktop on your own
playgroundTask.hint: Apps live in the strip along the bottom. Window buttons sit in the window's own title bar. The little icons at the top-right of the screen each open a panel.

steps.say: Get its window out of the way without closing it.
Make a window fill the whole screen.
Put it back to its smaller size.
Check how much battery is left.
Close the window you have open.

drDigitalSuccess: That is the whole desktop: opening apps, managing their windows, and reading the status icons. Nothing on a real computer works differently.
drDigitalHint: The dock is the row of icons at the bottom. Every window has three small buttons in its top bar — try each one. The clock and battery are at the top-right.
